title: Reliability Prioritization Scorecard: SLI-to-OKR Mapping & Auto-Prioritization
creator: Rae Thompson
description:
Problem: We lack a single source of truth that translates SLI trends and error-budget forecasts into ranked initiative recommendations tied to OKRs. PMs and SREs currently spend manual effort reconciling alerts, estimating customer impact, and deciding which mitigation initiatives to prioritize during a burn.

Goal: Deliver a Reliability Prioritization Scorecard: a lightweight UI and backend pipeline that ingests SLI time-series and change events, projects 7/30-day error-budget trajectories, maps affected SLIs to product OKRs and features, and outputs a ranked list of candidate initiatives with estimated customer impact and required effort. The scorecard must be actionable (links to runbooks, suggested mitigations) and integrate into the Initiative Hub for one-click create/attach to roadmap cycles.

Scope (MVP):
- Ingest SLI feeds for request latency and success-rate for three core routes: /api/generate, /api/embed, /api/health-check.
- Simple projection model for error budget burn (linear and exponential scenarios).
- Mapping table from SLI -> OKR/feature owners (editable CSV/console).
- Auto-prioritization algorithm that weights customer-facing impact, remaining error budget, and estimated implementation effort.
- UI widget in Console (Reliability tab) with ranked recommendations + links to runbooks and create-initiative button.
- Audit log entries for any auto-created initiatives.
acceptance_criteria: Scorecard ingests SLI series for the three routes at 1m granularity and shows recent 7/30-day burn projections.
Recommended initiatives are ranked and include estimated impact, effort, and suggested mitigations.
Create-initiative flow produces a PM ticket prepopulated with SLI context, links, and suggested priority.
UI exposes an editable mapping from SLI -> feature/OKR owner and persists changes to config store.
Telemetry: Count of recommendations, conversion rate to created initiatives, and mean time from recommendation to mitigation tracked in console-telemetry.
deliverables: PRD: Reliability Prioritization Scorecard (link in artifacts).
Backend ingestion pipeline and projection microservice (runtime-1.18 compatible).

Integration tests and canary rollout plan for Dedicated and Hosted tenants.

comments: Priya Patel (SRE): We should ensure projections are conservative for high-variance SLIs; propose a weekly smoothing option.
Marcus Lee (Eng): Will need a small KV cache for recent projections; estimate add'l 1 point if we keep high TTLs.
Ava Gomez (Design): Card UX should surface the most actionable next step (eg. 'Create canary rollout' or 'Increase retry budget').
Rae Thompson (PM): Add acceptance criteria for telemetry and conversion tracking so we can measure impact on MTTR.
risks: Automated prioritization may surface false positives if SLI-to-feature mapping is incomplete.
Projection models could under/over-estimate burn if traffic patterns shift suddenly (release storms).
Creating initiatives automatically has governance implications; require audit log and opt-out.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): Enable scorecard read-only for Internal tenants, collect feedback (2 weeks).
Phase 2 (opt-in): Allow create-initiative flow for product teams in a limited beta (4 weeks).
Phase 3 (GA): Default availability for all accounts with admin toggle and audit logs (target release console-2025.11).
